actions.createImage.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using any available model
actions.createImage.props.prompt.descrip: Text prompt describing the image you want to generate
actions.createImage.props.quality.descri: Image quality (not all models support this)
actions.createImage.props.responseFormat: How to receive the generated image
actions.createImage.props.size.descripti: Image size (e.g., 1024x1024). Use "auto" for default size.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.imageToImage.description: Generate or edit images using input image(s) with optional mask
actions.imageToImage.props.images.descri: Input image(s) for editing (up to 16 images)
actions.imageToImage.props.masks.descrip: Mask file(s) to specify areas to edit (some models require this)
actions.imageToImage.props.prompt.descri: Text prompt describing the image transformation
actions.imageToImage.props.quality.descr: Image quality (not all models support this)
actions.imageToImage.props.responseForma: How to receive the generated image
actions.imageToImage.props.size.descript: Image size (e.g., 1024x1024). Use "auto" for default size.
actions.image_router_create_chat_complet: Sends a conversation to a text model and returns its reply.

Optional JSON object of other OpenAI chat parameters passed to the model as-is, e.g. {"top_p":0.9,"response_format":{"type":"json_object"}}. Model, messages, temperature and max tokens above take precedence.
Maximum tokens in the reply. Leave empty for the model default.
The conversation as a JSON array of {"role", "content"} objects, e.g. [{"role":"system","content":"Be brief."},{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]. Roles: system, developer, user, assistant, tool.
Text model id, e.g. "openai/gpt-4o-mini". Use List Models with output modality "text" to find ids.
Sampling temperature from 0 to 2. Leave empty for the model default.
actions.image_router_create_response.des: Gets a reply from a text model in the OpenAI Responses format.
actions.image_router_create_response.pro: Optional JSON object of other OpenAI Responses parameters passed as-is, e.g. {"top_p":0.9}. The fields above take precedence.
The prompt as plain text. Use this or Input Items, not both.

The input as a JSON array of OpenAI Responses input items, e.g. [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"Describe this"},{"type":"input_image","image_url":"https://..."}]}]. Use this or Input, not both.
Optional system-level instructions for the model.
Maximum tokens in the reply. Leave empty for the model default.
Text model id, e.g. "openai/gpt-4o-mini". Use List Models with output modality "text" to find ids.
Sampling temperature from 0 to 2. Leave empty for the model default.
actions.image_router_edit_image.descript: Transforms or inpaints existing images and returns the new image URLs.
actions.image_router_edit_image.props.im: Source images, 1 to 16, each an http(s) URL or a data URI such as "data:image/png;base64,...".
actions.image_router_edit_image.props.ma: Optional mask images (URL or data URI) marking the area to edit, for models that support masks.
actions.image_router_edit_image.props.mo: Model id, e.g. "openai/gpt-image-2". Use List Models to find ids and what each model supports.
actions.image_router_edit_image.props.ou: Image file format. Defaults to webp.
actions.image_router_edit_image.props.pr: How to change the images. Most models need one; a few (e.g. upscalers) do not.
actions.image_router_edit_image.props.qu: Output quality for models that support it. Defaults to auto.
actions.image_router_edit_image.props.si: "auto" or WIDTHxHEIGHT such as "1024x1024". Allowed sizes per model are in Get Model. Defaults to auto.
actions.image_router_generate_image.desc: Generates images from a text prompt and returns their URLs.
actions.image_router_generate_image.prop: Model id, e.g. "openai/gpt-image-2". Use List Models to find ids and what each model supports.
Image file format. Defaults to webp.
Output quality for models that support it. Defaults to auto.
"auto" or WIDTHxHEIGHT such as "1024x1024". Allowed sizes per model are in Get Model. Defaults to auto.
actions.image_router_generate_video.desc: Generates a video from a prompt and an optional start image, and returns its URL.
actions.image_router_generate_video.prop: Optional start image for image-to-video models: an http(s) URL or a data URI.
Video model id, e.g. "ir/test-video". Use List Models with output modality "video" to find ids.
What the video should show. Most models need one.
Video length in seconds; allowed values per model are in Get Model (seconds). Defaults to the model default.
"auto" or WIDTHxHEIGHT such as "1280x720". Allowed sizes per model are in Get Model (sizes). Defaults to auto.
actions.image_router_get_credits.descrip: Gets the account credit balance and usage.
actions.image_router_get_credits.props.i: Also return usage for each API key on the account. Defaults to off.
actions.image_router_get_model.descripti: Gets one ImageRouter model with its parameters and pricing.
actions.image_router_get_model.props.mod: Exact model id, e.g. "openai/gpt-image-2", from List Models.
actions.image_router_list_models.descrip: Lists ImageRouter models with their modalities, parameters and pricing.
actions.image_router_list_models.props.f: Yes for free models only, No for paid models only. Leave empty for both.
actions.image_router_list_models.props.i: Only models accepting this input, e.g. image for editing or image-to-video models, mask for inpainting.
actions.image_router_list_models.props.l: Maximum models to return, 1 to 500. Defaults to 50.
actions.image_router_list_models.props.n: Model name or alias, partial and case-insensitive, e.g. "flux".
actions.image_router_list_models.props.o: Only models producing this: image, video or text.
actions.image_router_list_models.props.p: Provider name, partial and case-insensitive, e.g. "google" or "openai".
actions.image_router_list_models.props.s: Sort by name, provider, price or date (release date).
auth.description: Your ImageRouter API key. You can get your API key from the [ImageRouter API Keys page](https://imagerouter.io/api-keys).
description: Generate images with any model available on ImageRouter.
